name: Pacific Medical Prosthetics & Orthotics
old_description: Delivering Better Orthopedic Outcomes—One Patient, One Provider at a Time.
about:
Pacific Medical, Inc. was founded in 1987 by John Petlansky and is headquartered in Tracy, California. The company began with roots in eight western states and has grown into a nationally recognized distributor and service provider in the durable medical equipment space, focusing on orthopedic rehabilitation and surgical orthopedics.

The company operates 15 orthotic and prosthetic patient care facilities and 40 satellite offices across 18 western states. Its team comprises over 400 professionals, including more than 200 internal staff and a dedicated external sales and service force of over 215. Pacific Medical runs four divisions: OrthoLIFE, a proprietary patient-centered orthopedic rehabilitation and recovery platform; Surgical, providing innovative solutions for orthopedic and surgical care; Biologics, delivering advanced regenerative and biologic products; and Top Shelf Orthopedics, supporting product design, management, and distribution within the orthopedic space.

Pacific Medical serves healthcare providers, hospitals, and patients across the orthopedic continuum. Its customer base includes hospitals and clinical practices in 18 states, with the company reporting 540,000 lives changed in the most recent year. The firm specializes in orthopedic rehabilitation, arthroscopic surgery, sports medicine, prosthetics, and orthotics, positioning itself as a extension of its partners' practices.

The company emphasizes enduring partnerships built on trust, responsiveness, and a shared dedication to improving the quality of patient care. Its OrthoLIFE platform is designed to streamline care, improve outcomes, and support the unique needs of each facility, reflecting a stated commitment to innovation with integrity and partnerships with purpose.

old_description: Specialty food imports has been our passion since 1972. We  pride  ourselves  in  providing  our customers  and partners with the best possible  service  at competitive prices.
about:
Pacifica Foods Company, based in Vernon, California, has operated as a specialty food importer since its founding in 1972. The company remains privately held, though ownership details such as family or veteran status are not publicly disclosed.

The firm imports and distributes Italian food products, notably the Le 5 Stagioni line of pizza flours, fresh pasta flour, and gluten-free flour blends. Its catalog includes items such as Type “00” Pizza Napoletana, Superior, and Pasta Fresca flours, sold in 25-kilogram bags, as well as a gluten-free option in 500-gram packages. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

Pacifica Foods serves the food-service sector, supplying pizzerias, bakeries, and restaurants that require authentic Italian ingredients. The product range shown on its website targets professional kitchens producing Neapolitan-style pizza and fresh pasta.

name: Pajaro Valley Fabrication Inc.
old_description: At Pajaro Valley Fabrication, we understand the unique challenges in fabricating one-off or large-scale production items alike.
about:
Pajaro Valley Fabrication Inc. (PVFAB) operates from a 10,000-square-foot facility in Watsonville, California. The company was founded in 2006 and employs at least four full-time fabricators. Ownership structure and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The shop provides custom metal fabrication services including MIG, stick, flux-core, and TIG welding; waterjet cutting on a Flow Mach 2 machine with a 10-by-6-foot bed; shearing up to 3/8-inch steel and 1/4-inch stainless on two Amada hydraulic shears; bending up to 1/2-inch steel on two hydraulic presses; rolling of sheet metal, tubes, and solids; machining, drilling, and lathe work; hole punching and corner cutting; design assistance using current manufacturing software; and final assembly. The company also stocks and sells raw materials with value-added cutting, cleaning, and punching.

Agriculture accounts for roughly 65 percent of the business, with the balance split between commercial and residential customers. Typical projects range from agricultural equipment components and hydraulic system parts to truck beds with power lifts, trailers, lumber racks, sand-blasting tubes, custom gates, barbecue tables, fire pits, and stainless-steel countertops.

PVFAB emphasizes certified welders with more than 20 years of experience and a focus on minimal warping and extreme precision in waterjet cutting. The company states it builds industrial-grade products regardless of end use and aims to optimize productivity and streamline processes for both one-off and large-scale production runs.

about:
Pallas Textiles operates from Green Bay, Wisconsin. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure, and no founders are named in public materials. The business presents itself as a textile manufacturer focused on authenticity and craftsmanship.

The company produces upholsteries, panel fabrics, and privacy curtains, blending traditional weaving with modern fiber technologies. Its product lines are organized into curated collections such as Giverny, which includes six patterns — Monet, Ciel, Nymphea, Toile, Brume, and Aube — inspired by Claude Monet’s gardens. states and numerous international markets.

Healthcare facilities are a primary market, evidenced by the company’s presence at the Healthcare Design Expo and press materials emphasizing “curated colors, nature-inspired patterns, and exceptional performance to healing environments.” Interior designers, architects, and specifiers also constitute the customer base, served through direct sales specialists and sample fulfillment.

Pallas positions its differentiation on authenticity — “Being genuine is as important today as it ever was” — and the fusion of artisanal weaving with contemporary fiber science, summarized in the tagline “Made True.” The company also hosts hands-on design events where clients create custom accessories using Pallas textiles.

about:
Palmetto Sheet Metal operates from Dalzell, South Carolina, as a locally owned and operated fabrication shop. Founded on years of hands-on trade experience, the company specializes in sheet metal products for roofing, metal buildings, and custom projects, combining traditional workmanship with modern CNC equipment.

The shop produces roofing and metal building trim, architectural components, commemorative plaques, and custom one-off pieces using CNC precision. It handles orders ranging from single prototypes to large-scale production runs, serving residential, commercial, and industrial clients with a focus on accuracy and efficiency.

Customers span food service, HVAC, construction, and DIY markets, with contractors, builders, and homeowners among the typical buyers. The company also fabricates custom displays and personal sheet metal projects, extending its reach beyond traditional building trades.

Palmetto Sheet Metal emphasizes fast turnaround, broad material selection, and a responsive team, positioning its blend of old-school craftsmanship and modern tooling as its core differentiator. The mission centers on reliable quality, fair pricing, and a commitment to customer success.

name: Panic Plastics, Inc.
old_description: Panic Plastics, Inc. Your Own Thermoforming Division At The End Of Your Phone!
about:
Panic Plastics, Inc. operates from Payette, Idaho, where it has served as a thermoforming specialist for over 35 years. The company was founded to provide custom plastic packaging solutions, though the exact founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company designs, develops, and manufactures thermoformed plastic packaging including clamshell packages, blister packs, and thermoformed trays. It also produces printed blister cards and clamshell insert cards, and supplies blister and clamshell sealing equipment. Capabilities span thermoform design, tooling, and production, with a stock packaging program that eliminates mold costs and enables next-day shipment on standard items.

Panic Plastics serves a broad range of industries that require plastic packaging, working with nationally recognized brands across diverse sectors. Its customer base includes companies seeking both custom-engineered packaging and off-the-shelf stock solutions.

The company's stated mission is to manufacture the finest quality thermoformed packaging while delivering competitive pricing and on-time delivery. Core values emphasize respectful workplace conduct, ethical behavior, continuous improvement, and treating customers right. Panic Plastics positions itself as a full-service partner from initial design through high-tech tooling and manufacturing.

name: Papé Machinery Agriculture & Turf
old_description: Find reliable agriculture & turf equipment tailored to your budget.
about:
Papé Machinery Agriculture & Turf operates from its headquarters in Bend, Oregon, as an authorized John Deere dealer with a network spanning six western states. The company runs more than 35 full-service locations across Oregon, Washington, California, Nevada, and Idaho, positioning teams close to customers from the Willamette Valley to the High Desert.

The dealership sells new and used John Deere agriculture equipment — combines, sprayers, tillers, cultivators, and a range of tractors including compact utility models such as the 1025R, 2025R, 3025E, and 4044M. It also carries Stihl and Honda power equipment for residential and commercial use, plus John Deere Gator utility vehicles. Beyond sales, Papé provides parts through the Shop.Deere platform with illustrated diagrams and maintenance kits, and operates service centers offering scheduled maintenance, specials, and on-site support.

Customers include row-crop and specialty farms, commercial landscaping crews, and homeowners. In the Willamette Valley, Smith Bros. Farms relies on Papé for its multi-generational grass-seed operation. Commercial turf buyers access zero-turn and walk-behind mowers, while residential clients purchase chainsaws, trimmers, blowers, generators, and lawn tractors.

Papé emphasizes local availability, stating that its knowledgeable teams are positioned to maximize uptime. Parts orders are backed by dealership staff, and service specials aim to reduce downtime through preventive maintenance.

name: Paradise Energy Solutions
old_description: Means that the equipment for your new solar array is 100% exempt from MD sales and use taxes
about:
Paradise Energy Solutions is a family-owned, full-service solar energy company headquartered in Salisbury, Maryland, with a branch office in Hagerstown. Established as a family-owned operation, the company serves the Mid-Atlantic region from its two Maryland locations.

The firm designs and installs custom solar arrays for commercial, agricultural, and residential clients. Its services span site assessment, engineering, permitting, installation, and ongoing maintenance through its Paradise Protect service plans, which include annual performance analysis and repair recommendations. A team of solar installers, licensed electricians, project managers, and consultants handles projects from initial consultation through commissioning.

Customers include businesses seeking to offset operating costs, farms leveraging USDA loans and grants, and homeowners pursuing the federal investment tax credit and Maryland’s Solar Renewable Energy Certificates (SRECs). The company also assists clients with the state’s sales-and-use tax exemption on solar equipment.

Paradise Energy emphasizes its family-owned structure and dedicated service team as differentiators, offering existing customers a 10% discount on system checkups and positioning itself as a long-term partner for system performance.
